family: dictionary and counting tasks (frequencies, grouping, inverting mappings, merging)
spec: Count how often each character occurs in s, then return a list of (character, count) tuples for the n most frequent characters, ordered by count descending and, for ties, by character ascending. If n exceeds the number of distinct characters, return all of them. An empty string returns an empty list.

family: dictionary and counting tasks (frequencies, grouping, inverting mappings, merging)
spec: Given a list of dicts with numeric values, compute for each key that appears in at least one dict the average of its values across only the dicts that contain that key. Return a dict mapping each such key to its average (a float). An empty list returns an empty dict.

family: dictionary and counting tasks (frequencies, grouping, inverting mappings, merging)
spec: Count how many times each letter appears in s, treating uppercase and lowercase as the same letter and ignoring any non-letter characters. Return a dict mapping each lowercase letter that occurs to its total count. A string with no letters returns an empty dict.

family: dictionary and counting tasks (frequencies, grouping, inverting mappings, merging)
spec: Group the integers in nums by how many digits their absolute value has (e.g. 0 and -9 both have 1 digit, 100 has 3 digits). Return a dict mapping each digit count to a sorted list of the numbers with that many digits. An empty list returns an empty dict.

family: dictionary and counting tasks (frequencies, grouping, inverting mappings, merging)
spec: Given a list of candidate names (strings), count how many votes each candidate received. Return a dict mapping each candidate to their vote count. An empty list returns an empty dict.

family: dictionary and counting tasks (frequencies, grouping, inverting mappings, merging)
spec: Given a list of candidate names (strings), determine the winner: the candidate with the most votes. If several candidates are tied for the most votes, return the alphabetically smallest of them. The list is assumed non-empty.

family: dictionary and counting tasks (frequencies, grouping, inverting mappings, merging)
spec: Split text on whitespace and count how often each adjacent pair of words (a bigram) occurs, using a single space to join the pair into a key like 'word1 word2'. Return a dict mapping each bigram string to its count. A text with fewer than two words returns an empty dict.
visible_tests: assert count_bigrams('the cat sat') == {'the cat': 1, 'cat sat': 1}
hidden_tests: assert count_bigrams('one two one two') == {'one two': 2, 'two one': 1}
assert count_bigrams('a b c a b') == {'a b': 2, 'b c': 1, 'c a': 1}
assert count_bigrams('repeat repeat repeat repeat') == {'repeat repeat': 3}
assert count_bigrams('the quick brown fox the quick') == {'the quick': 2, 'quick brown': 1, 'brown fox': 1, 'fox the': 1}
assert count_bigrams('m n o m n') == {'m n': 2, 'n o': 1, 'o m': 1}
assert count_bigrams('cat dog cat dog cat') == {'cat dog': 2, 'dog cat': 2}
assert count_bigrams('a b a b a b') == {'a b': 3, 'b a': 2}
assert count_bigrams('z y x w') == {'z y': 1, 'y x': 1, 'x w': 1}
assert count_bigrams('p q r p q r p q') == {'p q': 3, 'q r': 2, 'r p': 2}
assert count_bigrams('same word same word') == {'same word': 2, 'word same': 1}

family: dictionary and counting tasks (frequencies, grouping, inverting mappings, merging)
spec: Return a sorted list of the keys that appear in both d1 and d2 and map to exactly the same value in each. Keys present in only one dict, or with differing values, are excluded. If there are no such keys, return an empty list.
reference:
def common_keys_with_equal_values(d1, d2):
    return sorted(k for k in d1 if k in d2 and d1[k] == d2[k])

family: dictionary and counting tasks (frequencies, grouping, inverting mappings, merging)
spec: For every key common to both d1 and d2, compute d1's value minus d2's value. Return a dict mapping each common key to that difference; keys unique to one dict are omitted. If there are no common keys, return an empty dict.
reference:
def dict_difference_values(d1, d2):
    return {k: d1[k] - d2[k] for k in d1 if k in d2}

family: dictionary and counting tasks (frequencies, grouping, inverting mappings, merging)
spec: Given a dict mapping labels to non-negative counts, convert each count to a percentage of the total (rounded to 2 decimal places). Return a dict with the same keys mapping to these percentages. If the total is zero (including an empty dict), every label maps to 0.

family: dictionary and counting tasks (frequencies, grouping, inverting mappings, merging)
spec: Split text on whitespace and return the number of distinct words (an integer), treating words case-sensitively. An empty or whitespace-only string returns 0.
visible_tests: assert count_unique_words('the cat sat on the mat') == 5
hidden_tests: assert count_unique_words('a b a b a b') == 2
assert count_unique_words('all different words here now') == 5
assert count_unique_words('z z z y y x') == 3
assert count_unique_words('one two three two one') == 3
assert count_unique_words('a a b b c c d') == 4
assert count_unique_words('x y z x y z x y z') == 3
reference:
def count_unique_words(text):
    return len(set(text.split()))

family: dictionary and counting tasks (frequencies, grouping, inverting mappings, merging)
spec: Split text on whitespace and find the words that occur exactly once. Return a sorted list of those words (case-sensitive, no duplicates since each occurs once anyway). An empty or whitespace-only string returns an empty list.
hidden_tests: assert words_appearing_once('x x y y z') == ['z']
assert words_appearing_once('one two three two one four') == ['four', 'three']
assert words_appearing_once('a b a c d c') == ['b', 'd']
assert words_appearing_once('m n m n o p') == ['o', 'p']
assert words_appearing_once('k j k j i') == ['i']
assert words_appearing_once('a b c a b c a') == []
assert words_appearing_once('only one appears here twice twice') == ['appears', 'here', 'one', 'only']

family: dictionary and counting tasks (frequencies, grouping, inverting mappings, merging)
spec: Split text on whitespace and find the distinct words that occur at least k times. Return a sorted list of those words. If k is 0 or negative, every distinct word qualifies. An empty or whitespace-only string returns an empty list.
hidden_tests: assert words_appearing_at_least('x y x y x', 2) == ['x', 'y']
assert words_appearing_at_least('z z z y y x', 3) == ['z']
assert words_appearing_at_least('m n m n m n', 2) == ['m', 'n']
assert words_appearing_at_least('one two one two three', 2) == ['one', 'two']
assert words_appearing_at_least('k j k j i', 1) == ['i', 'j', 'k']
assert words_appearing_at_least('a a b b b', 3) == ['b']
assert words_appearing_at_least('x x x x x', 10) == []

family: dictionary and counting tasks (frequencies, grouping, inverting mappings, merging)
spec: Find the value in items with the highest count. If several values tie for the highest count, return whichever of them appears first in the original list. The list is assumed non-empty.
hidden_tests: assert most_common_first_occurrence([True, False, True, False]) == True

family: dictionary and counting tasks (frequencies, grouping, inverting mappings, merging)
spec: Split text on whitespace and count words treating different letter casing as the same word (using the lowercase form as the key). Return a dict mapping each lowercased word to its total count. An empty or whitespace-only string returns an empty dict.
hidden_tests: assert count_words_case_insensitive('One Two one two ONE') == {'one': 3, 'two': 2}
assert count_words_case_insensitive('Mixed CASE Words mixed case words') == {'mixed': 2, 'case': 2, 'words': 2}
assert count_words_case_insensitive('a A b B c C') == {'a': 2, 'b': 2, 'c': 2}

family: dictionary and counting tasks (frequencies, grouping, inverting mappings, merging)
spec: Given a list of dicts with numeric values, merge them all together by summing values for keys that appear in more than one dict. Return a single dict containing every key seen, with each mapped to the sum of its values across all input dicts. An empty list returns an empty dict.

family: dictionary and counting tasks (frequencies, grouping, inverting mappings, merging)
spec: Given a list of (group, item) tuples, determine for each group how many distinct items it contains (duplicates within the same group counted once). Return a dict mapping each group to its distinct item count. An empty list returns an empty dict.

family: dictionary and counting tasks (frequencies, grouping, inverting mappings, merging)
spec: Given a list of (group, item) tuples, build a nested dict where each group maps to a dict counting how many times each item occurred within that group. Return the nested dict. An empty list returns an empty dict.

family: dictionary and counting tasks (frequencies, grouping, inverting mappings, merging)
spec: Given a (possibly nested) dict d and a list of keys, walk into the dict following each key in turn (d[keys[0]][keys[1]]...). Return the final value reached, or None if at any step the current value is not a dict or does not contain the next key. An empty keys list returns d itself.

family: dictionary and counting tasks (frequencies, grouping, inverting mappings, merging)
spec: Given a dict whose values are either plain values or further nested dicts, count the total number of leaf values (non-dict values) anywhere in the structure, recursively. An empty dict returns 0.
